subject: general
question: What was the name of the initiative launched by the Indian Prime Minister on World Environment Day in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 2.0**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 2.0** is an initiative launched by the **Indian Prime Minister** on **World Environment Day** in **2025**.
 
• This program is an extension of the original "Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam" initiative, which aimed to **encourage citizens to plant trees in honor of their mothers**.
 
• The initiative focuses on promoting **afforestation**, creating **green spaces**, and increasing **environmental awareness** among citizens.
 
• Specific measures under the program include distributing **free saplings**, organizing **tree-planting drives**, and conducting **workshops** on sustainable practices.
 
• The initiative aligns with India's commitment to the **Paris Agreement** and its goal of enhancing **carbon sinks** through afforestation and reforestation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Environment Day:**

 
 
• Celebrated annually on **5th June**, it is a global platform to raise awareness and take action for **environmental conservation**.
 
• The theme for World Environment Day 2025 was **"Restoring Balance: Nature and Humanity"**, emphasizing the need for sustainable practices.
 
 
 
• **Paris Agreement:**
 
 
• A landmark global treaty adopted in **2015** under the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)**.
 
• India has pledged to create additional **carbon sinks** of **2.5 to 3 billion tonnes of CO2 equivalent** by **2030** through afforestation.
 
 
 
• **Afforestation Initiatives in India:**
 
 
• Programs like **National Afforestation Programme (NAP)** and **Green India Mission** focus on increasing India's forest cover.
 
• India's forest and tree cover stands at **24.62%** of its geographical area, as per the **India State of Forest Report 2023**.
 
 
 
• **Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam (Original Initiative):**
 
 
• Launched earlier to honor mothers and promote tree planting as a tribute.
 
• Encouraged individuals to plant a tree every year in their mother’s name, creating a bond between **nature** and **human emotions**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Environmental Goals:**

 
 
• India aims to achieve **net-zero carbon emissions** by **2070**.
 
• Programs like **National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC)** focus on mitigating climate change impacts.
 
 
 
• **Role of Citizens:**
 
 
• Citizens are encouraged to actively participate in afforestation drives and adopt **sustainable practices**.
 
• Community involvement is critical for the success of initiatives like **Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam**.
 
 
 
• **Global Contributions:**
 
 
• India ranks among the top nations contributing to global afforestation efforts, as highlighted in the **Global Forest Resources Assessment**.
 
• Collaborations with international organizations like **UNEP** further bolster India's environmental initiatives.
